pairs.source_text: DECLARE @LineageKey int = NEXT VALUE FOR Sequences.LineageKey;

--IF EXISTS [FK_Fact_Sale_Bill_To_Customer_Key] ON [Fact].[Sale]

WHILE (:DATECOUNTER < '2012-12-31') LOOP
   OUTPUTCOUNTER := LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(:DATECOUNTER, 'yyyymmdd'), 20);
   SELECT
      <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.RAISERROR_UDF(:OUTPUTCOUNTER, 0, 1, array_construct());
      STARTINGSALEKEY := :MAXIMUMSALEKEY - :NUMBEROFSALESPERDAY - FLOOR(RANDOM() * 20000);
      ORDERCOUNTER := 0;
      INSERT INTO Fact.Sale
      ("City Key", "Customer Key", "Bill To Customer Key", "Stock Item Key", "Invoice Date Key", "Delivery Date Key", "Salesperson Key", "WWI Invoice ID", Description, Package, Quantity, "Unit Price", "Tax Rate", "Total Excluding Tax", "Tax Amount", Profit, "Total Including Tax", "Total Dry Items", "Total Chiller Items", "Lineage Key")
		SELECT
--		       TOP(:NUMBEROFSALESPERDAY)
      "City Key",
      "Customer Key",
      "Bill To Customer Key",
      "Stock Item Key",
      :DATECOUNTER,
      DATEADD(day, 1, :DATECOUNTER),
      "Salesperson Key",
      "WWI Invoice ID",
      Description,
      Package,
      Quantity,
      "Unit Price",
      "Tax Rate",
      "Total Excluding Tax",
      "Tax Amount",
      Profit,
      "Total Including Tax",
      "Total Dry Items",
      "Total Chiller Items",
      :LINEAGEKEY
      FROM
      Fact.Sale
      WHERE
      "Sale Key" > :STARTINGSALEKEY
      and "Invoice Date Key" >='2013-01-01'
		ORDER BY "Sale Key";
      DATECOUNTER := DATEADD(day, 1, :DATECOUNTER);
END LOOP;
OUTPUTCOUNTER := LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(:DATECOUNTER, 'yyyymmdd'), 20);

SELECT
   <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.RAISERROR_UDF(:OUTPUTCOUNTER, 0, 1, array_construct());
STARTINGSALEKEY := :MAXIMUMSALEKEY - :NUMBEROFSALESPERDAY - FLOOR(RANDOM() * 20000);
ORDERCOUNTER := 0;

pairs.source_text:
INSERT Fact.Sale WITH (TABLOCK)
			([City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], [Invoice Date Key],
			 [Delivery Date Key], [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description],
			 Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate], [Total Excluding Tax],
			 [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items],
			 [Lineage Key])
		SELECT TOP(@NumberOfSalesPerDay)
			   [City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], @DateCounter,
			   DATEADD(day, 1, @DateCounter), [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description],
			   Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate], [Total Excluding Tax],
			   [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items],
			   @LineageKey
		FROM Fact.Sale
		WHERE [Sale Key] > @StartingSaleKey
			and [Invoice Date Key] >='2013-01-01'
		ORDER BY [Sale Key];
